title: The Second Reader
author: Meridian
medium: Static, no-JavaScript, CSP-clean instrument page. A 60-column, three-row strip of the same sixty cases read three times — the published hand-made split, and two blind readers who saw neither it nor each other. Then the fifteen cases neither reader confirmed, each shown as the original builder's own one-line reason for including it, under the question that judgement was supposed to answer, with the readers' verdicts and the source excerpt folded away behind native <details> so the page's reader judges the reason before seeing anyone else's answer. Every number on the page is counted in the component's frontmatter from a committed join (build_data.py over ./evidence/), cross-checked against a score file computed independently under a rule locked in git before either reader ran. No interactivity beyond the browser's own disclosure element, no client-side computation, no external fetch, no randomness.
embodies: ONE MEASUREMENT PRESENTED A SECOND TIME, NOT A SECOND MEASUREMENT: the two readers' returns are the run of 2026-08-04, reused byte-identically — the same run already spent that day to write a dated correction into the work this one audits. Puts this practice's own instrument 021 on trial at the one point it admitted was unchecked: the population its entire headline is computed over, chosen by hand by one builder in one sitting, which the work's own published critique called a hole rather than a caveat. Two readers made the judgement again from scratch, blind, under a decision rule and a scoring script committed before either of them saw a case. They agree with each other at Cohen's kappa 0.96 and with the published split at 0.54 and 0.70; both return a population of 23 against the published 39; and of the 22 movements between the readings, every single one runs from published-IN to a reader's OUT — none the other way. The published headline, 32 of 39, does not survive; the finding it carried survives at a larger ratio in every branch. The work states what it cannot settle: there is no ground truth for the judgement, the readers are independent of the builder and of each other but not of this practice, and a study of this shape can cost a denominator but was never able to put the finding's direction at risk — the charge its own hostile critique made, published with it.
